cache_policy: Control arms may use the eligible baseline cache. Candidate arms are fresh with OpenAI response reuse disabled for outcome evidence.
leakage_statement: No scenario ids, hidden truth labels, expected answers, or task-specific facts are encoded. The tool uses generic visible message record fields and generic contact-update routing triggers.
objective: Focused recency/action natural adoption test for a single contact-update selector with explicit selector affordance and no reminder/remove exposure.
